description: Darin of Talking Island Village has fallen in love with Gatekeeper Roxxy. He is too shy to express his feelings and asks you to deliver his love letter to her.\n
short_description: Darin, a young man on Talking Island, carries a torch for Gatekeeper Roxxy, who doesn't return his affections. Darin is not so easily dissuaded, however.

description: Roxxy reads Darin's letter and tells you that she admires him as well. She asks you to deliver her kerchief to him. Take Roxxy's kerchief to Darin in the village square.\n
short_description: Darin, a young man on Talking Island, carries a torch for Gatekeeper Roxxy, who doesn't return his affections. Darin is not so easily dissuaded, however.

description: Darin is overjoyed to learn that Roxxy returns his admiration, and says he wants to ask her for a date. He asks you to go and get a love potion promised to him by Magister Baulro at the temple.\n
short_description: Darin, a young man on Talking Island, carries a torch for Gatekeeper Roxxy, who doesn't return his affections. Darin is not so easily dissuaded, however.

description: Magister Baulro admits that he deceived Darin about the potion in order to bolster his courage. He gives you a medicine bottle filled with tap water. Take it to Darin in the village square.\n
short_description: Darin, a young man on Talking Island, carries a torch for Gatekeeper Roxxy, who doesn't return his affections. Darin is not so easily dissuaded, however.

description: Arujien confesses to you that he has pined for Magister Greenis for a long time. He asks you to find out if Greenis returns his affection. Meet with her younger sister, Gatekeeper Mirabel, and show her Arujien's letter.\n
short_description: Arujian, a young man in the Elven Village, adores Magister Greenis with all his heart, but no one knows if Greenis returns his affections.

description: Gatekeeper Mirabel says that she doesn't get involved in her sister's affairs. She suggests that you ask Trader Herbiel. You will find him in a magic shop. Show him Arujien's Letter.\n
short_description: Arujian, a young man in the Elven Village, adores Magister Greenis with all his heart, but no one knows if Greenis returns his affections.

description: Trader Herbiel thinks that Magister Greenis likes Arujien. Go back to Arujien and give him the good news.\n
short_description: Arujian, a young man in the Elven Village, adores Magister Greenis with all his heart, but no one knows if Greenis returns his affections.

prog_name: Feelings that Have Turned into a Poem
description: Arujien says that he's written a book of poetry for Greenis. Take Arujien's poetry book to Magister Greenis.\n
short_description: Arujian, a young man in the Elven Village, adores Magister Greenis with all his heart, but no one knows if Greenis returns his affections.

description: Magister Greenis informs you that she loves another. Take Greenis' letter of refusal to Arujian.\n
short_description: Arujian, a young man in the Elven Village, adores Magister Greenis with all his heart, but no one knows if Greenis returns his affections.

description: Dark Elven Tetrarch Talloth is continuing in the studies of the dark arts in order to break the seal that binds Mitraell, the leader of the Dark Elves. He asks that you to go to the school of the Dark Arts and bring him an Omen Beast's eye, a Taint Stone and Succubus Blood which are all needed to break the Seal.  This being the first stage among three stages that binds the great leader.\n\monsters to be hunted - Omen Beast, Tainted Zombies, Stink Zombies, Lesser Succubi, Lesser Succubus Turen and Lesser Succubus Tilfos\n
short_description: The Human has betrayed the secret that's kept Hierarch Mitraell sealed for centuries! Help Tettrarch Talloth break the seal that binds Mitraell!

description: You have collected all the ingredients required for a spell. Return to Hierarch Talloth.\n
short_description: The Human has betrayed the secret that's kept Hierarch Mitraell sealed for centuries! Help Tettrarch Talloth break the seal that binds Mitraell!

description:
Pa'agrio Lord Kakai, the ruler of all the Orcs, has fallen ill. The Centurions have decreed that each tribe shall offer him gifts to improve his health. Centurion Nakusin asks you to collect the offerings from the six tribes. You must meet with the following tribal representatives:

Tataru Zu Hestui of the dignified Hestui tribe
Chief Varkees of the cold-blooded Atuba tribe
Warehouse Keeper Grookin of the formidable Neruga tribe
Gantaki Zu Urutu of the strong-willed Urutu tribe
Trader Kunai of the tactical Dudamara tribe
Trader Uska of the ruthless Gandi tribe.
short_description: Pa'agrio Lord Kakai, the leader of all the Orcs, is sick! The elders have decided that each tribe will need to deliver a present to him to ensure he has a speedy recovery.

description: You have collected all of the tributes for Pa'agrio Lord Kakai. Take them to Centurion Nakusin.\n
short_description: Pa'agrio Lord Kakai, the leader of all the Orcs, is sick! The elders have decided that each tribe will need to deliver a present to him to ensure he has a speedy recovery.

description: Miner Bolter, a member of the Gray Pillar Guild, lives at the Strip Mine. He asks you to bring him some things from the village. Visit Trader Shari's weapons shop, Trader Garita's store, Warehouse Chief Reed and Blacksmith Brunon and bring back the items that Miner Bolter is seeking.\n
short_description: The guildsmen of the Gray Pillar Guild are hard at work in the Strip Mine. Miner Bolter is concerned that no one is available to gather the supplies the village needs.

description: You have all of the items Bolter requested. Take them to him.\n
short_description: The guildsmen of the Gray Pillar Guild are hard at work in the Strip Mine. Miner Bolter is concerned that no one is available to gather the supplies the village needs.

description: Grand Master Roien of Cedric's Training Hall wants to restore the sword of solidarity. He explains that the sword was made long ago to symbolize the friendship between Elves and Humans. He mentions that Blacksmith Altran is also very interested in restoring this relic. He asks you to take the letter containing the results of his investigation of the relic to Altran in the Blacksmith Shop.\n
short_description: The Sword of Solidarity has long symbolized the friendship between Elves and Humans. The disappearance of the sword has coincided with the deterioration of that friendship. Grand Master Roien is seeking a warrior to restore the sword to its place of honor.

description: Blacksmith Altran explains that if he is to restore the Sword of Solidarity to its original condition, he must have the two pieces of the blade. He asks you to go the Elven Ruins and obtain the broken sword blade pieces from the Orcs there. Hunt Tunath Orc Warriors and Tunath Orc Marksmen.\n
short_description: The Sword of Solidarity has long symbolized the friendship between Elves and Humans. The disappearance of the sword has coincided with the deterioration of that friendship. Grand Master Roien is seeking a warrior to restore the sword to its place of honor.

description: Take the broken sword blade pieces to Blacksmith Altran.\n
short_description: The Sword of Solidarity has long symbolized the friendship between Elves and Humans. The disappearance of the sword has coincided with the deterioration of that friendship. Grand Master Roien is seeking a warrior to restore the sword to its place of honor.

description: While Blacksmith Altran joins the sword blade pieces together, go to Cedric's Training Hall and obtain the broken sword handle from Grand Master Roien.\n
short_description: The Sword of Solidarity has long symbolized the friendship between Elves and Humans. The disappearance of the sword has coincided with the deterioration of that friendship. Grand Master Roien is seeking a warrior to restore the sword to its place of honor.

description: Take the broken sword handle to Blacksmith Altran so he can restore the sword of solidarity to its original condition.\n
short_description: The Sword of Solidarity has long symbolized the friendship between Elves and Humans. The disappearance of the sword has coincided with the deterioration of that friendship. Grand Master Roien is seeking a warrior to restore the sword to its place of honor.

description: Sentinel Knight Alberius tells you that the Elven researchers who have recently gone to the Sea of Spores have come down with a fever. He is concerned about the guards he has dispatched there and asks for your help. He tells you that Master Cobendell has the cure for the fever but needs the ingredients to make the antidote. Go to Master Cobendell and help him to collect the ingredients he needs.\n
short_description: Sentinels who were conducting experiments in the Sea of Spores have all come down with a bad fever. Sentinel Knight Alberius is seeking someone to visit Master Cobendell to obtain the cure.

description: You must collect dryad's tears to make the cure for the fever. Collect 10 dryad's tears in the Elven Forest and take them to Master Cobendell. Hunt dryads and dryad elders.\n
short_description: Sentinels who were conducting experiments in the Sea of Spores have all come down with a bad fever. Sentinel Knight Alberius is seeking someone to visit Master Cobendell to obtain the cure.

description: You have collected all the necessary Dryad tears. Take them to Master Cobendell in the Elven Village.\n
short_description: Sentinels who were conducting experiments in the Sea of Spores have all come down with a bad fever. Sentinel Knight Alberius is seeking someone to visit Master Cobendell to obtain the cure.

description: The medicine for the fever has been created! Take it to Sentinel Knight Alberius.\n
short_description: Sentinels who were conducting experiments in the Sea of Spores have all come down with a bad fever. Sentinel Knight Alberius is seeking someone to visit Master Cobendell to obtain the cure.

description: Sentinel Knight Alberius asks you to deliver the fever medicine to four sentinels who have gone to the Sea of Spores. Take the medicine to Sentinel Berros, Sentinel Veltress, Sentinel Rayen and Sentinel Gartrandell.\n
short_description: Sentinels who were conducting experiments in the Sea of Spores have all come down with a bad fever. Sentinel Knight Alberius is seeking someone to visit Master Cobendell to obtain the cure.

description: You have distributed the fever medicine. Report back to Sentinel Knight Alberius.\n
short_description: Sentinels who were conducting experiments in the Sea of Spores have all come down with a bad fever. Sentinel Knight Alberius is seeking someone to visit Master Cobendell to obtain the cure.

description: The Dark Elven Blacksmith, Karrod, wishes to conjure the spirit of Warsmith Roberto Steelbender in order to learn how to refine oriharukon ore. He asks for help in summoning the dead man's spirit. Visit Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon of the Temple of Shilen.\n
short_description: Karrod from the Dark Elf Village is the best of all Elven blacksmiths. In spite of his awesome skill, he still cannot refine oriharukon ore. Summon a Dwarf Warsmith to discover the secret!

prog_name: Net for Tying Up Dead Spirits
description: Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon tells you that in order to summon Steelbender from the Well of Dead Souls he will need a soul catcher. Visit Magister Harne and ask him how to get a soul catcher.\n
short_description: Karrod from the Dark Elf Village is the best of all Elven blacksmiths. In spite of his awesome skill, he still cannot refine oriharukon ore. Summon a Dwarf Warsmith to discover the secret!

description: 10 old bones are needed to make a soul catcher. Go to the School of Dark Arts, kill skeletons and bring back their bone fragments. Kill skeleton hunters, archers and doom soldiers.\n
short_description: Karrod from the Dark Elf Village is the best of all Elven blacksmiths. In spite of his awesome skill, he still cannot refine oriharukon ore. Summon a Dwarf Warsmith to discover the secret!

description: You have collected all 10 bone fragments. Return to Magister Harne in Dark Elf Village and have the soul catcher made.\n
short_description: Karrod from the Dark Elf Village is the best of all Elven blacksmiths. In spite of his awesome skill, he still cannot refine oriharukon ore. Summon a Dwarf Warsmith to discover the secret!

description: A soul catcher has been created! Take it to Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon.\n
short_description: Karrod from the Dark Elf Village is the best of all Elven blacksmiths. In spite of his awesome skill, he still cannot refine oriharukon ore. Summon a Dwarf Warsmith to discover the secret!

description: The preparations for summoning Steelbender have almost all been completed. All that remains is to obtain a zombie head to temporarily hold the spirit. Go to the Swampland, kill a zombie and bring back its head. Hunt marsh zombies.\n
short_description: Karrod from the Dark Elf Village is the best of all Elven blacksmiths. In spite of his awesome skill, he still cannot refine oriharukon ore. Summon a Dwarf Warsmith to discover the secret!

description: You have applied the preserving oil to the zombie head. Take it to Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon before it begins to rot.\n
short_description: Karrod from the Dark Elf Village is the best of all Elven blacksmiths. In spite of his awesome skill, he still cannot refine oriharukon ore. Summon a Dwarf Warsmith to discover the secret!

description: Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon has conjured the soul of Steelbender by using the soul catcher. He then channels the spirit into the zombie head. Take it to Blacksmith Karrod before it starts to rot.\n
short_description: Karrod from the Dark Elf Village is the best of all Elven blacksmiths. In spite of his awesome skill, he still cannot refine oriharukon ore. Summon a Dwarf Warsmith to discover the secret!

description:
The spirits of mirrors that Grand Magister Gallint was studying have escaped! Hit each one of them with Gallint's oak wand to seal them. Seal all three and return to Gallint. The guards in the village can tell you where to find the spirits.

Monsters that need to be sealed by Gallint's Oak Wand – 3 spirits of mirrors.
short_description: Three Spirits of Mirror have escaped from Magister Gallint's laboratory on Talking Island! Capture and seal these spirits!

description:
The spirits of mirrors that Grand Magister Gallint was studying have escaped! Hit each one of them with Gallint's oak wand to seal them. Seal all three and return to Gallint. You will find one of them on the western shore of the island, another near the bridge west of Einhovant's School of Wizardry and the third can be found near the Obelisk of Victory.

Monsters that need to be sealed by Gallint's Oak Wand – 3 spirits of mirrors.
short_description: Three Spirits of Mirror have escaped from Magister Gallint's laboratory on Talking Island! Capture and seal these spirits!

description: You have sealed all three of the spirits of mirrors with Gallint's oak wand! Return to Grand Magister Gallint.\n
short_description: Three Spirits of Mirror have escaped from Magister Gallint's laboratory on Talking Island! Capture and seal these spirits!

description: Orcs have recently made several attacks upon the Elven Forest. The Elves have decided to take their revenge upon the Kaboo Orcs in the Misty Mountains. Read the order from Sentinel Kendell and hunt the Orcs!\n
short_description: Kaboo Orcs from the Misty Mountains have invaded the Elven Forest again. Help Sentinel Kendell and the Elven Fighters defeat the invaders and take the head of the Orc Captain!

description: You have destroyed the Kaboo Orcs! Report to Sentinel Kendell.\n
short_description: Kaboo Orcs from the Misty Mountains have invaded the Elven Forest again. Help Sentinel Kendell and the Elven Fighters defeat the invaders and take the head of the Orc Captain!

description: The war has not yet been won. Kaboo Orcs are massing around Iris Lake in the southern part of the village and are preparing to launch an invasion! You must follow Sentinel Kendell's orders! Slay the Kaboo Orcs!\n
short_description: Kaboo Orcs from the Misty Mountains have invaded the Elven Forest again. Help Sentinel Kendell and the Elven Fighters defeat the invaders and take the head of the Orc Captain!

description: You've successfully accomplished Kendell's second order! Return to Sentinel Kendell in the Elven Village and make your report to him.\n
short_description: Kaboo Orcs from the Misty Mountains have invaded the Elven Forest again. Help Sentinel Kendell and the Elven Fighters defeat the invaders and take the head of the Orc Captain!

description: Dark Elven Tetrarch Thifiell asked Abyssal Celebrant Kartia to translate an ancient manuscript. He now asks you to retrieve the translated copy of "Kaysha's Revelations". You must be very discreet.\n
short_description: The infamous Orc Brigand has stolen Kaysha's Revelations! Retrieve this vital document to secure the future of all Dark Elves!

prog_name: In Search of the Stolen Revelations
description: You hear that "Kaysha's Revelations" was stolen by Tumran Orcs! Kill the Tumran Orc brigands that were last seen camping near the Altar of Rites, and recover the original copy of "Kaysha's Revelations" and a clay tablet.\n
short_description: The infamous Orc Brigand has stolen Kaysha's Revelations! Retrieve this vital document to secure the future of all Dark Elves!

description: You have recovered the ancient scroll and clay tablet. Abyssal Celebrant Kartia is waiting for you.\n
short_description: The infamous Orc Brigand has stolen Kaysha's Revelations! Retrieve this vital document to secure the future of all Dark Elves!

description: The translation of "Kaysha's Revelations" is complete. Tetrarch Thifiell is waiting for you.\n
short_description: The infamous Orc Brigand has stolen Kaysha's Revelations! Retrieve this vital document to secure the future of all Dark Elves!

description: Baranka, Shaman of Darkness, is scheming to destroy the kingdom of the Orcs. Urutu Chief Hatos has learned of his plot, and has ordered the elimination of all of Baranka's followers. Kill them all! Centurion Parugon will tell you where to find them.\n
short_description: The exiled traitor Baranka schemes to overthrow the kingdom of the Orcs! Reveal his wicked plot and destroy him! Dejakar Oroka!

description: Baranka's messengers and escorts are advancing from the far eastern Immortal Plateau to the Frozen Waterfalls! Kill them all!\n
short_description: The exiled traitor Baranka schemes to overthrow the kingdom of the Orcs! Reveal his wicked plot and destroy him! Dejakar Oroka!

description: You have recovered a secret letter from Baranka's messenger. Take it to Urutu Chief Hatos.\n
short_description: The exiled traitor Baranka schemes to overthrow the kingdom of the Orcs! Reveal his wicked plot and destroy him! Dejakar Oroka!

description:
Baranka must have sent more than one secret letter! Find Baranka's messengers and try to find other secret letters!

 Monsters to Hunt - Baranka's messengers.
short_description: The exiled traitor Baranka schemes to overthrow the kingdom of the Orcs! Reveal his wicked plot and destroy him! Dejakar Oroka!

description: You've found another secret letter! Take it to Urutu Chief Hatos.\n
short_description: The exiled traitor Baranka schemes to overthrow the kingdom of the Orcs! Reveal his wicked plot and destroy him! Dejakar Oroka!

description:
This can't be the end! Search harder!

 Monsters to Hunt - Baranka's messengers.
short_description: The exiled traitor Baranka schemes to overthrow the kingdom of the Orcs! Reveal his wicked plot and destroy him! Dejakar Oroka!

prog_name: Discovery of the third secret letter!
description: You've found another secret letter! Take it to Urutu Chief Hatos.\n
short_description: The exiled traitor Baranka schemes to overthrow the kingdom of the Orcs! Reveal his wicked plot and destroy him! Dejakar Oroka!

prog_name: In Search of a Star Diamond!
description: Collector Gouph of the Bronze Key Guild has purchased a rare star diamond from Trader Reep of the Silver Scales Guild. It is one of only twelve on the continent! Three days have past since the agreed-upon delivery date and Gouph is becoming impatient. He asks you to go to Trader Reep, retrieve the star diamond and bring it to him.\n
short_description: The Star Diamond is one of only 12 on the entire continent! The Dwarves are planning a Jumble, Tumble, Diamond Fuss!

description: Trader Reep informs you that he gave the star diamond to Carrier Torocco to deliver to Gouph. Find Torocco and ask him about the diamond.\n
short_description: The Star Diamond is one of only 12 on the entire continent! The Dwarves are planning a Jumble, Tumble, Diamond Fuss!

description: Torocco got drunk with Miner Maron last night and passed out. When he awoke, his weapons, armor, money and even the star diamond had been stolen! Find Maron and ask him what happened.\n
short_description: The Star Diamond is one of only 12 on the entire continent! The Dwarves are planning a Jumble, Tumble, Diamond Fuss!

prog_name: Gambling can make you a loser, too!
description: Carrier Torocco is usually quite trustworthy, but.when he starts drinking he inevitably starts gambling. He got drunk last night and lost everything he had in a dice game with Blacksmith Brunon. Could this mean that Blacksmith Brunon has the star diamond?\n
short_description: The Star Diamond is one of only 12 on the entire continent! The Dwarves are planning a Jumble, Tumble, Diamond Fuss!

description: Indeed, Blacksmith Brunon won the star diamond in a dice game! He tells you that he will give it to you if you recover the aquamarine and chrysoberyl that were stolen by a goblin brigand lieutenant.\n
short_description: The Star Diamond is one of only 12 on the entire continent! The Dwarves are planning a Jumble, Tumble, Diamond Fuss!

description: You have recovered the aquamarines and chrysoberyls that Blacksmith Brunon lost. Take them to him.\n
short_description: The Star Diamond is one of only 12 on the entire continent! The Dwarves are planning a Jumble, Tumble, Diamond Fuss!

description: Brunon gives you the gem box he says he won in a dice game. Take it to Gouph.\n
short_description: The Star Diamond is one of only 12 on the entire continent! The Dwarves are planning a Jumble, Tumble, Diamond Fuss!

description: The gem box doesn't contain the star diamond, only a strange looking piece of coal! Return to Blacksmith Brunon and demand an explanation!\n
short_description: The Star Diamond is one of only 12 on the entire continent! The Dwarves are planning a Jumble, Tumble, Diamond Fuss!

description: The piece of coal once belonged to Warehouse Freightman Murdoc. Take the letter from Brunon to Murdoc and exchange it for the gem box that contains the star diamond.\n
short_description: The Star Diamond is one of only 12 on the entire continent! The Dwarves are planning a Jumble, Tumble, Diamond Fuss!

description: The star diamond was eaten by a bat that Warehouse Keeper Airy keeps as a pet! The bat escaped out of an open window! Go quickly and speak with Airy!\n
short_description: The Star Diamond is one of only 12 on the entire continent! The Dwarves are planning a Jumble, Tumble, Diamond Fuss!

prog_name: Who keeps a bat as a pet, anyway?
description: Warehouse Keeper Airy asks you to find her pet, a blade bat. Kill the bat and get the diamond.\n
short_description: The Star Diamond is one of only 12 on the entire continent! The Dwarves are planning a Jumble, Tumble, Diamond Fuss!

description: You finally recover the star diamond. Pray for the soul of the poor bat then take the star diamond to Collector Gouph.\n
short_description: The Star Diamond is one of only 12 on the entire continent! The Dwarves are planning a Jumble, Tumble, Diamond Fuss!

description: Elias, a Master at the School of Wizardry, has been gathering herbs in the northern woods with some students. The students have fallen ill, and Priest Yohanes has been asked to create a remedy. He needs the poison sacs of many spiders, and you are asked to bring them to him.\n
short_description: The students of Einhovant's School of Magic have come down with a mysterious fever. Their teacher, Elias, is quite concerned.

prog_name: Creation of the Cure for the Fever
description: You have obtained the poison sacs of giant spiders. Take them immediately to Priest Yohanes and ask him to make the medicine!\n
short_description: The students of Einhovant's School of Magic have come down with a mysterious fever. Their teacher, Elias, is quite concerned.

description: Priest Yohanes made fever medicine with the poison sacs you collected for him. Take the medicine for the students of the School of Wizardry to Master Elias immediately!\n
short_description: The students of Einhovant's School of Magic have come down with a mysterious fever. Their teacher, Elias, is quite concerned.

description: A few days ago the roof of the temple was wrecked by a storm. Magister Harrys has asked Blacksmith Altran for tools with which to repair the roof. He asks you to pick up the tools from Blacksmith Altran.\n
short_description: The roof of Einhasad Temple has collapsed! Help Magister Harrys restore the temple!

description: Blacksmith Altran asks you to obtain shards of golem for him so he can make a new hammer.\n
short_description: The roof of Einhasad Temple has collapsed! Help Magister Harrys restore the temple!

description: You have obtained five shards of golem. Take them to Blacksmith Altran and ask him to make a hammer for you.\n
short_description: The roof of Einhasad Temple has collapsed! Help Magister Harrys restore the temple!

description: Blacksmith Altran asks you to deliver the hammer and a tool box containing other tools to Magister Harrys.\n
short_description: The roof of Einhasad Temple has collapsed! Help Magister Harrys restore the temple!

description: Guard Arnold, who has been working on the recovery of several recent shipwrecks, asks you to deliver some salvaged goods. Deliver the wooden box to Trader Jackson in the weapons shop. Deliver the bolts of cloth to Trader Silvia at the grocery store, and deliver the clay jar to Warehouse Keeper Rant.\n
short_description: Cargo that was presumed lost in a recent shipwreck has been recovered. Help Guard Arnold deliver the cargo to its recipients.

description: You have delivered the salvaged goods. Report to Guard Arnold.\n
short_description: Cargo that was presumed lost in a recent shipwreck has been recovered. Help Guard Arnold deliver the cargo to its recipients.

description: In order to calm the violent storms that have battered the island, Lighthouse Keeper Rockswell is planning a ritual sacrifice to the goddess Shilen. The original ritual calls for a live maiden, but he decides to offer a doll instead. To make the hair of the doll, he needs fox fur. Hunt keltirs around the village and take 10 units of fox fur to Cristel in the village.\n
short_description: Lighthouse Keeper Rockswell plans a ritual sacrifice to calm the storms that have been battering the island. This time he intends to use a doll instead of a live virgin.

description: You have obtained 10 units of fox fur. Take them to Cristel.\n
short_description: Lighthouse Keeper Rockswell plans a ritual sacrifice to calm the storms that have been battering the island. This time he intends to use a doll instead of a live virgin.

description: The fox fur yarn for the doll's hair has been spun. Take it to Warehouse Keeper Rolfe.\n
short_description: Lighthouse Keeper Rockswell plans a ritual sacrifice to calm the storms that have been battering the island. This time he intends to use a doll instead of a live virgin.

description: Warehouse Keeper Rolfe has made the doll and attached its hair. Take the finished doll to Lighthouse Keeper Rockswell.\n
short_description: Lighthouse Keeper Rockswell plans a ritual sacrifice to calm the storms that have been battering the island. This time he intends to use a doll instead of a live virgin.

description: Guard Abellos tells you that an urgent message has arrived from Gludio Castle for Sir Collin Windawood, the Consul of Talking Island. He asks you to deliver the message to the Consul near the Obelisk of Victory.\n
short_description: An important letter has arrived for Sir Colin Windawood, the Consul of Talking Island. Sir Windawood, more likely to be found out on a stroll  than in his office, hasn't seen it. Find Sir Windawood and deliver the letter to him.

description: Lilith has pined for her lost love for over a thousand years in the temple of Talking Island. She lost her lover, Theon, in the war against Beleth. Because his body was never recovered, she has never accepted his death. She asks you to look for him on your way to Gludio.\n
short_description: The ramifications of the ancient battle with the devil, Beleth, still linger in this land. Lilith still grieves for her lost lover, Theon, at Einhasad Temple. His body wasn't recovered, so she's never truly accepted his death. She's waited for him for 1000 years at their agreed-upon meeting place on Talking Island...

description: Master Baenedes bears a  remarkable resemblance to Theon. He was one of his best students, and learned to use both the sword and bow from him. Sadly, Theon passed away to be with Eva several years ago. Baenedes asks you to deliver Theon's diary to Lilith.\n
short_description: The ramifications of the ancient battle with the devil, Beleth, still linger in this land. Lilith still grieves for her lost lover, Theon, at Einhasad Temple. His body wasn't recovered, so she's never truly accepted his death. She's waited for him for 1000 years at their agreed-upon meeting place on Talking Island...

description: Warehouse Keeper Wilfred has been smuggling goods in violation of the embargo enacted after the war with Gracia. Recently, a merchant ship was stranded, spilling adamantite ore all over the shore. Much of the ore was recovered, but giant toads are swallowing what remains of it. Hunt the giant toads and recover the ore.\n
entity_name: The Lake Shore Near the School
short_description: Warehouse Keeper Wilford is breaking the trade embargo against Gracia that was imposed after the recent war. He should be careful...

description: You've recovered all the adamantite ore scattered on the shore. Take it to Warehouse Keeper Wilford.\n
short_description: Warehouse Keeper Wilford is breaking the trade embargo against Gracia that was imposed after the recent war. He should be careful...

description: High Priest Biotin had a premonition from his dreams that something wicked is growing within the Elven Ruins. He says that the evil seed looks like a gigantic bat-winged demon. He asks you to destroy it.\n
short_description: Evil has spawned in the long-abandoned Elven Ruins! High Priest Biotin was warned of this menace in a dream and is gathering forces to fight the evil.

description: You have slain Nerkas, the evil seed, and obtained the clay tablet. Take it to High Priest Biotin at the temple in the village.\n
short_description: Evil has spawned in the long-abandoned Elven Ruins! High Priest Biotin was warned of this menace in a dream and is gathering forces to fight the evil.

prog_name: In Search of the Source of Pollution
description: Elven Hierarch Asterios is concerned that the Mother Tree of the village is being contaminated. He asks you to visit its water source, the lake north of the village. Destroy the cause of the contamination, the plague zombies.\n
short_description: Someone has intentionally poisoned the water supply of Elven Village! Hierarch Asterios is seeking a young volunteer to find and destroy this evil-doer to save the Mother Tree!

description: You've obtained plague dust from a suspicious looking zombie. Could this be what Hierarch Asterios was talking about? Take it to him.\n
short_description: Someone has intentionally poisoned the water supply of Elven Village! Hierarch Asterios is seeking a young volunteer to find and destroy this evil-doer to save the Mother Tree!

description: It was a plague zombie, the spirit of a person who died from the plague. The dust from the zombie's flesh has been the cause of the contamination. A large amount of the dust is needed to perform a purification ritual. Hunt the plague zombies.\n
short_description: Someone has intentionally poisoned the water supply of Elven Village! Hierarch Asterios is seeking a young volunteer to find and destroy this evil-doer to save the Mother Tree!

description: You've obtained enough plague dust for the purification ritual. Deliver it to Hierarch Asterios.\n
short_description: Someone has intentionally poisoned the water supply of Elven Village! Hierarch Asterios is seeking a young volunteer to find and destroy this evil-doer to save the Mother Tree!

description: Trader Unoren asked Nerupa to collect silvery spidersilks for him. Norupa doesn't want to enter the village and asks you to deliver the silvery spidersilks to Trader Unoren in the weapons shop and bring back a nightshade leaf.\n
short_description: Nerupa, the caretaker of the Mother Tree, is seeking a volunteer to visit the village on her behalf. The Hierarch will not permit her to go there.

description: Nightshade leaves are very rare. Fortunately, Trader Creamees of the magic shop has obtained a few of them. Go see him with Unoren's receipt.\n
short_description: Nerupa, the caretaker of the Mother Tree, is seeking a volunteer to visit the village on her behalf. The Hierarch will not permit her to go there.

description: Since nightshade leaf is so rare it has been stored in the warehouse. Take Creamees' ticket to Warehouse Keeper Julia.\n
short_description: Nerupa, the caretaker of the Mother Tree, is seeking a volunteer to visit the village on her behalf. The Hierarch will not permit her to go there.

prog_name: Goods to be delivered to Nerupa.
description: You've obtained the nightshade leaf that Creamees stored in the warehouse. Deliver it to Nerupa.\n
short_description: Nerupa, the caretaker of the Mother Tree, is seeking a volunteer to visit the village on her behalf. The Hierarch will not permit her to go there.

description: Andellia and her sisters care for the Mother Trees. You received a letter informing you that the Mother Tree near Iris Lake, maintained by their younger sister Thalia, has borne fruit. Since Andellia and her sisters cannot leave the Mother Trees untended, they ask you to visit Thalia and bring back the fruit of the Mother Tree.\n
short_description: Elves owe their long lifespans to their consumption of the fruit of the Mother Tree. The caretakers of the tree are quite concerned about the recent decline in production of fruit.

description: Thalia gives you the fruit of the Mother Tree that was harvested some time ago. This was the only fruit she harvested this year. She asks you to carefully take it to her sister Andellia.\n
short_description: Elves owe their long lifespans to their consumption of the fruit of the Mother Tree. The caretakers of the tree are quite concerned about the recent decline in production of fruit.

prog_name: The Way to Undo a Curse
description: Trader Unoren explains that the undead creatures in the Underground Fortress are soldiers resurrected by a curse. He wants to quiet the vengeful spirits and free the souls of his comrades. He asks that you bring him bone fragments of undead monsters and skulls of Elves. Hunt dungeon skeleton soldiers, dungeon skeleton archers, dread soldiers, dark terrors and mist terrors.\n
short_description: Ancient spirits have begun haunting the ruins of the Dark Elven war in the Underground Fortress. They cry out for revenge...

description: You've collected all the skulls and bone pieces needed to break the curse. Return to the Elven Village and give them to Trader Unoren.\n
short_description: Ancient spirits have begun haunting the ruins of the Dark Elven war in the Underground Fortress. They cry out for revenge...

description: Sentinel Starden is a veteran of the battle of the Underground Fortress. Rumiel the poet, a longtime friend and fellow soldier, died in battle and his poems were lost within the fortress. Starden asks you to find his old friend's works somewhere in the Underground Fortress. Hunt Baraq Orc fighters and Baraq Orc warrior leaders.\n
short_description: Rumiel Moonshine, an amazing poet, entertains his companions with dark poetry, detailing the dread and sorrow of war. Alas, he succumbed too young to the violence he so eloquently described... But his soul lives on in his writings, hidden amongst the ruins of the Underground Fortress!

description: You've recovered all four poems written by Rumiel the poet. Take them to Sentinel Starden.\n
short_description: Rumiel Moonshine, an amazing poet, entertains his companions with dark poetry, detailing the dread and sorrow of war. Alas, he succumbed too young to the violence he so eloquently described... But his soul lives on in his writings, hidden amongst the ruins of the Underground Fortress!

description: Trader Creamees' friends and family were all killed by the dark side. Kirunak, the leader of the dark side, still lurks within the Underground Fortress. Creamees asks you to seek revenge upon Kirunak.\n
short_description: Bloody Lord Kirunak, the leader of the dark ones, killed many brave Elven warriors at the final battle of the Underground Fortress! Legend says that he still lurks near that ruined battlefield! Arise, Elven warriors! Revenge is ours at last!

description: With his dying breath, Kirunak tells you that his contract with Trader Creamees has been fulfilled. Wasn't it a Dark Elf who originally summoned Kirunak? Return to Creamees and find out what happened.\n
short_description: Bloody Lord Kirunak, the leader of the dark ones, killed many brave Elven warriors at the final battle of the Underground Fortress! Legend says that he still lurks near that ruined battlefield! Arise, Elven warriors! Revenge is ours at last!

description: Shilen's Hunt will soon be held in the Dark Elf Village. Wild game will be hunted and offered as an sacrifice. The hunter who obtains 13 dark bezoars will receive a reward given by the Abyssal Celebrants. Hunt keltirs and wolves, obtain 13 dark bezoars and take them to Sentry Nelsya. Hunt young brown keltirs, brown keltirs, ashen wolves and elder brown keltirs.\n
short_description: The Mass of Darkness in honor of Shilen is about to begin. Prepare for the Hunt of Glory! Take your bows and arrows and find offerings for the Mother of Abyss!

description: You've collected all 13 dark bezoars. Take them to Sentry Nelsya immediately and claim your prize and the honor of being this year's best hunter.\n
short_description: The Mass of Darkness in honor of Shilen is about to begin. Prepare for the Hunt of Glory! Take your bows and arrows and find offerings for the Mother of Abyss!

prog_name: Items Needed for the Mass of Darkness.
description: Abyssal Celebrant Undrias is busily preparing for the ceremony of Shilen and Gran Kain. He asks you to go to the village and obtain several items that he will need for the Mass of Darkness. He asks for the following: a ceremonial dagger from Trader Iria in the Weapons Shop, dreviant wine from Warehouse Keeper Dorankus, and Garmiel's scripture from Master Trudy of the Elder Council.\n
short_description: The Mass of Darkness is performed in honor of Shilen, the mother of all Dark Elves. Let's all work together to make this the best festival ever!

description: You've obtained the ceremonial dagger, the dreviant wine and Garmiel's scripture that are needed for the Mass. Take them to Abyssal Celebrant Undrias.\n
short_description: The Mass of Darkness is performed in honor of Shilen, the mother of all Dark Elves. Let's all work together to make this the best festival ever!

description: The Dwarven Warehouse Freightman Carlon misses his friends and asks you to deliver a letter to Warehouse Keeper Haprock in the Town of Gludio.\n
short_description: Warehouse Keeper Carlon hasn't seen his family since he was captured by Dark Elves ten years ago. He seeks someone to deliver a message to his brother Haprock in the Town of Gludio.

description: Haprock thanks you for delivering the letter to him. He asks you to deliver a letter to Warehouse Keeper Norman in Gludin Village. The letter is supposed to be from Norman's wife, longing for him in his hometown... Do you believe him...?\n
short_description: Warehouse Keeper Carlon hasn't seen his family since he was captured by Dark Elves ten years ago. He seeks someone to deliver a message to his brother Haprock in the Town of Gludio.

description: Sentry Jenna says that according to Tetrarch Kaitar's prophecy, the Dark Forest will soon be invaded by outside forces. To prepare for the attack, all Sentries are optimizing their weapons. Master Harant has promised to provide them with new weapons, and they ask you to fetch them.\n
short_description: Tetrarch Kaitar is known to see the future. He has forseen that the village will soon come under attack.

description: Master Harant has given you three sentry blades onto which he has bestowed magic power. He asks you to deliver them to Sentry Jenna.\n
short_description: Tetrarch Kaitar is known to see the future. He has forseen that the village will soon come under attack.

description: Sentry Jenna asks you to immediately deliver the completed swords to her sisters. Deliver the swords to Sentry Roselyn and Sentry Kristin, collect the old bronze swords that they have been using and bring them back.\n
short_description: Tetrarch Kaitar is known to see the future. He has forseen that the village will soon come under attack.

description: You have delivered all the swords. Take the bronze swords to Sentry Jenna.\n
short_description: Tetrarch Kaitar is known to see the future. He has forseen that the village will soon come under attack.

description: Magister Vlasty is researching the dark horror, an undead monster. He needs unbroken skulls for the research, and asks you to hunt dark horrors and bring the skulls back to him. Dark horrors are found in the swamps southwest of the village. Even broken skulls will fetch you some adena.\n
short_description: Magister Vlasty is researching the ancient monster known as the dark horror.

description: You have obtained intact skulls of dark horrors. Take them to Magister Vlasty for a reward. He also pays for broken skulls, but not as much.\n
short_description: Magister Vlasty is researching the ancient monster known as the dark horror.

description: Dark Elven Tetrarch Vellior cannot sleep because of terrible nightmares caused by a succubus. You're asked to kill the Q1959 at the School of Dark Arts.\n
short_description: The dreams of Tetrarch Vellior are constantly haunted by a mysterious, beautiful woman! Discover the truth of her origin in the ruins of the School of Dark Arts!

description: Merkenis's dying words were about Lich King Icarus. Who is he? What was the source of Tetrarch Vellior's torment? Take the nightmare crystal to the Tetrarch and make a report.\n
short_description: The dreams of Tetrarch Vellior are constantly haunted by a mysterious, beautiful woman! Discover the truth of her origin in the ruins of the School of Dark Arts!

description:
Kash says that anyone who wants to get the mark of challenger should enter the cave behind the Undine Waterfall in the northern part of the Neutral Zone, destroy Shyslassys and retrieve an old parchment.


Monster to Hunt - The Shyslassys
restricions: Warrior, Elven Knight, Palus Knight, Orc Monk, Orc Raider
short_description: Many Warriors seek the challenger's mark as proof of their valor. A conspiracy of darkness surrounds the mark.

short_description: Many Warriors seek the challenger's mark as proof of their valor. A conspiracy of darkness surrounds the mark.

restricions: Warrior, Elven Knight, Palus Knight, Orc Monk, Orc Raider
short_description: Many Warriors seek the challenger's mark as proof of their valor. A conspiracy of darkness surrounds the mark.

short_description: Many Warriors seek the challenger's mark as proof of their valor. A conspiracy of darkness surrounds the mark.

description:
Gorr's defeat has not made the people of Floran Village any safer. They're now threatened by another evil creature. Find and destroy Baraham in the caves near Gorr's lair.

Monster to Hunt -  Baraham
restricions: Warrior, Elven Knight, Palus Knight, Orc Monk, Orc Raider
short_description: Many Warriors seek the challenger's mark as proof of their valor. A conspiracy of darkness surrounds the mark.

restricions: Warrior, Elven Knight, Palus Knight, Orc Monk, Orc Raider
short_description: Many Warriors seek the challenger's mark as proof of their valor. A conspiracy of darkness surrounds the mark.

description: Champion Raldo warns of an evil that will be resurrected unless a magic force field remains protected. Speak with Filaur of the Gray Pillar in the Dwarven Village and ask him where the last magic force field was known to exist.\n
restricions: Warrior, Elven Knight, Palus Knight, Orc Monk, Orc Raider
short_description: Many Warriors seek the challenger's mark as proof of their valor. A conspiracy of darkness surrounds the mark.

description:
There's an evil energy in the deepest part of the Mithril Mines and the magic force field is threatened. Why is there earth wyrm blood everywhere? Could that Succubus Queen be their leader? 

Monster to Hunt -  Succubus Queen
restricions: Warrior, Elven Knight, Palus Knight, Orc Monk, Orc Raider
short_description: Many Warriors seek the challenger's mark as proof of their valor. A conspiracy of darkness surrounds the mark.

description: At the death of the Succubus Queen, Raldo reappears. Speak with him.\n
restricions: Warrior, Elven Knight, Palus Knight, Orc Monk, Orc Raider
short_description: Many Warriors seek the challenger's mark as proof of their valor. A conspiracy of darkness surrounds the mark.

description: Sometimes, being a mere Knight just isn't enough. Knights who wish to advance should find Sir Aron Tanford south of the Wastelands and undergo the Trial of Duty. \n
restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight
short_description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

description:
A true Knight must always seek to restore honor when possible. Sir Herod, after betraying his troops and dying in disgrace, has been resurrected as an evil spirit. Kill the undead skeletons that haunt the Wastelands and you'll meet him. You must destroy him with the old knight sword in order to restore his honor. Return to Sir Aron Tanford when you've finished off Sir Herod.

Monsters to Hunt - Skeleton Marauder, Skeleton Raider and Ghost of Sir Herod
restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight
short_description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight
short_description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

description: Unfortunately, Sir Herod was beyond redemption. That can't be helped now. Speak with Sir Kiel Nighthawk in the Dark Elf Guild of the Town of Dion to receive your second mission.\n
restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight
short_description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

description:
There's been a vicious massacre in Dion! Sir Talianus's report  for the King was ripped up and his soldiers have become undead! Obtain the torn pieces of the report from the undead in the Dion Execution Grounds and restore the report of Sir Talianus.

Monsters to Hunt - Strains, Ghouls
restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight

restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight
short_description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

description:
Take this report, find the spirit of Sir Talianus and promise to submIt to the King on his behalf. This will allow his spirit to at last rest in peace. Meet the spirit of Sir Talianus by destroying the hangman tree that suppresses his soul.

Monster to Hunt -  Hangman Tree
restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight
short_description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight
short_description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

description: Sir Talianus asks you to deliver his report to the King. His spirit can't rest in peace until his sins are redeemed and justice is restored to the land of Dion. Return to Sir Kiel Nighthawk and tell him what you've learned.\n
restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight
short_description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight
short_description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight
short_description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

description: Take the 20 militia's articles you've collected to Isael.\n
restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight
short_description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight
short_description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

description:
Priest Dustin tells you the story of Leon Athebaldt, the protector of the will of Einhasad. He asks that you kill the Breka Orc Overlord and retrieve Sir Athebaldt's bones from around his neck. Find the Overlord in the Breka Stronghold.

Monster to Hunt -  Breka Orc Overlord
restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight
short_description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight
short_description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

description: When you return with the bones of Leon Athebaldt, Dustin asked you to take them to Sir Collin Windawood, Leon's uncle.  He's an archon on Talking Island.\n
restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight
short_description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

description: Sir Collin Windawood asks you to deliver his letter of gratitude to Priest Dustin. \n
restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight
short_description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

restricions: Human Knight, Elven Knight, Palus Knight
short_description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

description: Mutant evil spirits threaten the kingdom. The guild has decided to begin a secret investigation into their activities. Only Seekers can accomplish this task. You must find someone to help you. The letter describes that person.\n
short_description: The peace of the kingdom is threatened by mutant evil spirits. The Seeker Guild wants to conduct secret reconnaissance to find out what they're up to. It's a tough, dangerous job. Are you certain that you're prepared to follow the Path of the Seeker?

prog_name: Mutant Evil Spirits in the Execution Grounds
description:
Master Terry is concerned about the increasing number of mutants in the area and asks you to hunt the neer ghoul berserker on the Execution Grounds near the village.

Monster to Hunt -  Neer Ghoul Berserker

description: To advance your learning, you must pass the Trial of the Scholar. Find the renowned Mystics and do as they say!\nFirst, you should seek out High Priest Sylvain in the Town of Dion.\n
restricions: Human Wizard, Elven Wizard, Dark Wizard
short_description: Every Magus must pass the Trial of the Scholar. Passion and humility are essential to success.

description: High Priest Sylvain asks that you obtain the crystal of purity from Maria in the village so he can purify the Execution Grounds.\n
restricions: Human Wizard, Elven Wizard, Dark Wizard
short_description: Every Magus must pass the Trial of the Scholar. Passion and humility are essential to success.

restricions: Human Wizard, Elven Wizard, Dark Wizard
short_description: Every Magus must pass the Trial of the Scholar. Passion and humility are essential to success.

description: Unfortunately, Maria's scroll has not yet been found. Go and tell her.\n

description: Captain Lucas isn't sure that the shadow belongs to the thief, but it appears to belong to a Leto lizardman Warrior!\n
