Devil's Isle: Bloody Bat, Unpleasant Humming, Death Flyer, Fiend Archer, Musveren, Zaken's Royal Guard, Kaim Vanul, Pirate Zombie Captain, Doll Blader, Vale Master, Sairon, Sairon's Doll, Sairon's Puppet, Light Bringer
Timak Outpost: Timak Orc Series, Timak Orc Troop Series
Fields of Massacre: Doom Servant, Doom Guard, Doom Archer, Doom Trooper, Doom Warrior, Doom Knight
Giants Cave: Halingka, Yintzu, Paliote, Hamrut, Kranrot
Forest of Mirrors: Forest of Mirrors Ghost, Mirror, Harit Lizardman, Harit Lizardman Grunt, Harit Lizardman Archer
Tower of Insolence: Erin Ediunce, Platinum Series, Angel Series
Garden of Eva: Nos, Blade Stakato Series, Water Giant, Queen Undine Lad, Eva's Seeker, Theeder Piker, Theeder Mage, Doll Master, Light Worm, Garden Guard Leader, Garden Guard
short_description: A great, unknown darkness looms on the horizon... Sensing the coming chaos, the Magisters and Maestros are preparing secret ways to counter the threat.

description: Locksmith Dorothy asks you to determine what happened to her recently vanished friends who disappeared along with a pirate's treasure. She fears that they were eaten by Crokians on the Field of Whispers and wants you to search there for their bones. Hunt Crokians and crokian warriors.\n
short_description: After many hardships, Locksmith Dorothy and her friends succeeded in stealing the treasure of the legendary pirate, Zaken! The shining fang awaited them near the village.

prog_name: In Search of a Dark Elf
description: You find Dorothy's friends' bones but no other clues. Dorothy tells you a rumor of a clay jar, in the possession of the Dark Elf Guild, that supposedly has the power to raise the dead.\n
short_description: After many hardships, Locksmith Dorothy and her friends succeeded in stealing the treasure of the legendary pirate, Zaken! The shining fang awaited them near the village.

description: Magister Xenovia sells you the magic powder needed to summon dead souls with the clay jar.\n
short_description: After many hardships, Locksmith Dorothy and her friends succeeded in stealing the treasure of the legendary pirate, Zaken! The shining fang awaited them near the village.

description: You have spoken with the spirit of the victim through the medium's jar.\n
short_description: After many hardships, Locksmith Dorothy and her friends succeeded in stealing the treasure of the legendary pirate, Zaken! The shining fang awaited them near the village.

description: The spirit in the medium's jar was no friend of Dorothy.\n
short_description: After many hardships, Locksmith Dorothy and her friends succeeded in stealing the treasure of the legendary pirate, Zaken! The shining fang awaited them near the village.

description: Elder Cronos suggests you consult Fairy Mimyu concerning the raising of Hatchling to Strider.\n
restricions: At least Hatchling Level 55, One Dragonflute
short_description: Raising a fat, lazy hatchling isn't an easy task! You shall now reap the harvest of your hard work!

description: Fairy Mimyu examines your hatchling and tells you the story of the four fairy trees and their guardians. She tells you to feed the sap of these trees to your hatchling. Go to each of the four fairy trees of wind, star, twilight and abyss and let your hatchling drink their sap. You must guard your hatchling as it drinks. When it has finished drinking, attach a fairy leaf to the fairy tree.\n
restricions: At least Hatchling Level 55, One Dragonflute
short_description: Raising a fat, lazy hatchling isn't an easy task! You shall now reap the harvest of your hard work!

description: Your hatchling has drunk the sap of all four fairy trees-- the wind, star, twilight and abyss. The preparations for its growth have been completed. Return to Fairy Mimyu.\n
restricions: At least Hatchling Level 55, One Dragonflute
short_description: Raising a fat, lazy hatchling isn't an easy task! You shall now reap the harvest of your hard work!

description: Captain Gosta of Heine asks you to kill the Tasaba lizardmen that stole the cargo belonging to Iason Heine's Commercial Guild. Slay the Tasaba lizardmen and bring back their fangs or the barrels of league that were stolen and Iason Heine will give you a reward. Kill the Tasaba lizardmen and Tasaba lizardmen shamans.\n
short_description: Tasaba lizardmen have stolen cargo belonging to Iason Heine, owner of the the most successful commercial guild in Heine! Kill the lizardmen and recover the cargo!

description: The cargo belonging to the Commercial Guild of Iason Heine has been stolen by Tasaba lizardmen. You are hunting them. Bring back their fangs and Iason Heine will give you a reward. Recover the barrels of league that were stolen and he will give you some bills of Iason Heine worth 1000 adena each. If you take them to Head Blacksmith Roman in Heine he will exchange them for items.\n
short_description: Tasaba lizardmen have stolen cargo belonging to Iason Heine, owner of the the most successful commercial guild in Heine! Kill the lizardmen and recover the cargo!

description: The soul of Reiria, Maestro Reorin's dearly departed wife, is being held hostage by demons. He asks that you free her by slaying Messenger Cabrio and recovering the soul orb. He was last seen lurking in the northern part of the cemetery.\n
short_description: Many travelers looking for new hope follow the whispers of the lady of the wind!  Keep heart! You shall soon acquire the flame of purgatory!

description: In order to restore his honor, Maestro Reorin wishes to recover his masterpiece from the demons. He asks that you recover his three infernium scepters from Death Lord Hallate, his aide Kernon and Longhorn Golkonda, who can be found in the Tower of Insolence.\n
short_description: Many travelers looking for new hope follow the whispers of the lady of the wind!  Keep heart! You shall soon acquire the flame of purgatory!

description: Maestro Reorin asks that you go to Warehouse Freightman Cliff in the Town of Oren and obtain infernium varnish so he may continue his enhancement of the infernium scepters.\n
short_description: Many travelers looking for new hope follow the whispers of the lady of the wind!  Keep heart! You shall soon acquire the flame of purgatory!

description: Maestro Reorin asks that you recover his hammer from Head Blacksmith Ferris in Aden Castle Town, who confiscated it after expelling the maestro from the guild.\n
short_description: Many travelers looking for new hope follow the whispers of the lady of the wind!  Keep heart! You shall soon acquire the flame of purgatory!

description: Go to Trader Zenkin in the Town of Oren and recover the maestro-level mold that he bought from Reorin.\n
short_description: Many travelers looking for new hope follow the whispers of the lady of the wind!  Keep heart! You shall soon acquire the flame of purgatory!

description: Trader Zenkin informs you that Maestro Reorin's mold has already been sold to Magister Kaspar of Hardin's Academy. Try to obtain the mold from him.\n
short_description: Many travelers looking for new hope follow the whispers of the lady of the wind!  Keep heart! You shall soon acquire the flame of purgatory!

description: Magister Kaspar offers to give you Reorin's mold in exchange for a sample of the blood of Baium. Baium is the emperor of the ancient empire who is sealed in a room atop the Tower of Insolence.  He is said to have turned into a beast-like creature. Magister Hanellin of Aden Castle Town will tell you how to enter his room. When you attack him, you must use a pipette knife and stab him with it.\n
short_description: Many travelers looking for new hope follow the whispers of the lady of the wind!  Keep heart! You shall soon acquire the flame of purgatory!

prog_name: While Holding the Mold in Your Hand
description: Take the mold back to Maestro Reorin.\n
short_description: Many travelers looking for new hope follow the whispers of the lady of the wind!  Keep heart! You shall soon acquire the flame of purgatory!

description: B-Grade crystals are required to process melted infernium. Obtain and take 984 of them to Maestro Reorin.\n
short_description: Many travelers looking for new hope follow the whispers of the lady of the wind!  Keep heart! You shall soon acquire the flame of purgatory!

prog_name: Equipment to be Used as an Offering
description: You must melt a B-Grade weapon and mix it with infernium to create  a new alloy to neutralize the harmful aura of infernium. Obtain and take a B-Grade weapon to Maestro Reorin.\n
short_description: Many travelers looking for new hope follow the whispers of the lady of the wind!  Keep heart! You shall soon acquire the flame of purgatory!

main_name: Help Rood Raise A New Pet!
description: Pet Manager Rood of Heine wants to raise a new pet. He asks you to obtain lienrik eggs. A lienrik is a beautiful beast that lives in the Field of Silence. Female lienrik eggs are much rarer than male lienrik eggs. Hunt lienriks and lienrik lads.\n
short_description: Could it be true that a beautiful, noble pet has been discovered in the silent field of reeds?

description: Galman is a businessman in Dragon Valley. He is very depressed because his lover is dying. Out of desperation he has begun delving into the powers of darkness. He asks you to find him a stone of contract. Hunt the Malruk succubus and the Malruk succubus turens.\n
short_description: Galman spends his time alone in Dragon Valley... Nobody wants to go near him, but he has a story to tell...

description: Warehouse Freightman Kluck of Heine intends to develop a free trade zone on Alligator Island. He asks you to wipe out the evil creatures there and bring him their teeth as proof. Take 100 or more proofs to him at once and he will give you a bonus. Hunt crokian lads, dailaon lads, crokian lad warriors, farhite lads, nos lads and swamp tribes.\n
short_description: After being driven from their trade routes from Giran to Innadril by the Humans, the Dwarven guild authorities agreed to establish new markets for their goods. However, they may get more than they bargained for...

description: Although Trader Galibredo of the Town of Oren is now a mere merchant, his roots are aristocratic. Some time ago, he purchased several busts made by the ancient sculptor, Berona. As they were being delivered to him they were stolen by orcs. He desperately wishes to recover the ancient statues, regardless of the cost. He promises an extra reward each time you bring him 100 or more statues. Hunt Timak orc troop archers, warriors, troop leaders and troop shamans.\n
short_description: Trader Galibredo claims to have royal blood in his veins.  He claims to be a descendant of a distinguished aristocratic family of the ancient Elmoreden Empire. He seeks to regain the glory of the past and restore himself to his rightful place of honor…

main_name: Dig Up the Sea of Spores!
description: Magister Gauen of the Ivory Tower wishes to perform an in-depth study of the Sea of Spores. He asks that you bring him 50 carnivore spores and 50 herbivorous spores. Perhaps he would settle for just 50 of one type... Hunt rotting trees and spore zombies.\n
short_description: The Wizards of the Ivory Tower have sought to stem the spread of the Sea of Spores since ancient times. Now they want a permanent solution to this problem.

main_name: Dig Up the Sea of Spores!
prog_name: Continue collecting? Or will you return?
description: You've filled a spore sac. Do you wish to fill the other sac or do you wish to return to Magister Gauen at the Ivory Tower? Hunt rotting trees and spore zombies.\n
short_description: The Wizards of the Ivory Tower have sought to stem the spread of the Sea of Spores since ancient times. Now they want a permanent solution to this problem.

main_name: Dig Up the Sea of Spores!
description: You've filled up both of the spore sacs. Return to Magister Gauen at the Ivory Tower.\n
short_description: The Wizards of the Ivory Tower have sought to stem the spread of the Sea of Spores since ancient times. Now they want a permanent solution to this problem.

description: Warehouse Freightman Silva wishes to become the next Warehouse Chief. She intends to obtain this position through the jade crystal business. She asks that you collect jade crystals for her. She offers an extra reward if you bring her 100 or more jade crystals at a time. You should hunt forest runners, Fline elders, Liele elders and valley treant elders.\n
short_description: Warehouse Chief Baxt recently announced retirement, and the competition to replace him has already grown fierce among the freightmen.

description: To protect Shilen's reputation, Grand Master Oltlin asks you to destroy the evil creatures that are evidence of her descent into madness. Collect 108 snake scales from the evil creatures that look like her and take them to Grand Master Oltlin. You will find them in front of the Forbidden Gateway. Hunt Falibati and Trives.\n
short_description: Dark Elves think of Shilen as their mother, as she may well be, but children born of such lunacy are bound to cast a dark shadow...

description: You have collected 108 snake scales. Take them to Grand Master Oltlin of Dark Elf Guild in Aden Castle.\n
short_description: Dark Elves think of Shilen as their mother, as she may well be, but children born of such lunacy are bound to cast a dark shadow...

prog_name: Eternal Rest to Soldiers of the Castle
description: Knight Gustav of Elmore has resurrected the dead heroes of Aden to serve his evil purposes. Recover 60 of their remains and take them to High Priest Orven in Aden Castle so that they can be laid to rest. Hunt doom archers, doom guards and doom servants.\n
short_description: The king's bitterness at his defeat was so great that it even transcended his death! To this day, he wanders his ruined castle...

description: You have collected 60 corpses. Take them to High Priest Orven in Aden Castle and perform the ceremony of purification.\n
short_description: The king's bitterness at his defeat was so great that it even transcended his death! To this day, he wanders his ruined castle...

description: Go back to see High Priest Orven after he has finished praying.\n
short_description: The king's bitterness at his defeat was so great that it even transcended his death! To this day, he wanders his ruined castle...

description: Monsters are defiling the Cemetery where the heroes of this kingdom are buried. You are part of the forces pledged to drive them out. You must interrupt their supply line, kill them and take all the supplies and documents they are carrying to Guard Coleman in Aden Castle Town. Hunt Taik orc seekers and Taik orc supply leaders.\n
short_description: Kings, nobles and heroes are buried in the National Cemetery. Since the collapse of the kingdom, this holy place has been overrun with monsters! There are evil forces behind this.

description: Pirate Zaken's followers imprisoned him on Devil's Isle and stole his treasure, but he eventually got his revenge by killing them all and turning them into pirate zombies and pirate zombie captains. You must go there, conduct an investigation, recover the stolen treasure, and take it to Warehouse Keeper Randolf in Giran Castle Town.\n
short_description: Pirate Captain Zaken searched for treasure all his life. While he died an untimely death, his curse lives on, on Devil's Isle!

prog_name: Bring Back a Strand of Silver Hair
description: Magister Dieter of Giran Castle Town wishes to obtain the silver hair of Sairon which can be found on Devil's Isle. Rumor says that this hair is what gives the doll its power. Go to Devil's Isle and slay Sairon, her doll and puppet, and then take some of her silver hair to Magister Dieter.\n
short_description: Devil's Isle is home to the restless spirits of Pirate Captain Zaken and his men. That island holds some ghastly secrets...

prog_name: Bzzt Bzzt Wow, What a Blast!
description: Researcher Lorain says that she has discovered the secret of the Titan's energy. She asks that you use an ancient item in a fight against Catherok, the monster of Cruma Tower and thereby expose the ancient item to the influence of the skill Catherok uses.\n
short_description: All the best discoveries are accidental! What scientific secrets might we learn from the ancient giants?

description: The Titan lamp must be returned to Lorain.\n
short_description: All the best discoveries are accidental! What scientific secrets might we learn from the ancient giants?

description: The Garden of Eva is the goddess' sanctuary. Lately, monsters have been invading it, and the garden guards are overwhelmed. Priestess Restina of Heine has requested the help of outsiders to drive out the monsters. Kill blade stakatos, blade stakato workers, blade stakato warriors, and blade stakato drones.\n
short_description: The Garden of Eva is the holy sanctuary of the Goddess of Water! What are all those evil creatures doing there?!

description: Magister Nell is researching the Forgotten Temple. After learning of a relationship between the Forgotten Temple and the Elven Ruins, she asks you to bring her back broken fragments of elemental stone. Obtain 50 flame shards and 50 ice shards. Hunt roxides, lakin undines, rowin undines, death fires, lakin salamanders and salamander rowins.\n
short_description: Magister Nell wants to know the connection between the soul stone found at the Elven Ruins on Talking Island and the one found at the Forgotten Temple... And that's not her only question!

description: You have collected 50 ice shards and 50 flame shards. Take them to Magister Nell in Gludin Village.\n
short_description: Magister Nell wants to know the connection between the soul stone found at the Elven Ruins on Talking Island and the one found at the Forgotten Temple... And that's not her only question!

prog_name: Jewel Collection For the Sake of Love
description: You have collected the spirit ore needed for Nell's research. Her instructor now requests that you bring the him some ore, too. Hunt the roxide, Lakin undine, rowin undine, death fire, Lakin salamander and salamander rowin.\n
short_description: Magister Nell wants to know the connection between the soul stone found at the Elven Ruins on Talking Island and the one found at the Forgotten Temple... And that's not her only question!

description: You have collected 200 ice shards and 200 flame shards. You must take these heavy items to Magister Nell in Gludin Village.\n
short_description: Magister Nell wants to know the connection between the soul stone found at the Elven Ruins on Talking Island and the one found at the Forgotten Temple... And that's not her only question!

description: Great Magus Kranvel's spellbook has been opened for the upcoming fight with Beleth. The magic power emanating from the book has destroyed fertile farmland and produced weird and grotesque creatures. Filled with rage and grief, Spellsinger Diena destroyed the magus's spellbook. Rumor says it is now located in the Ant Nest. Elder Casian wishes to open Great Magus Kranvel's spellbook again. Obtain the Great Magus Kranvel's spellbook so he can recultivate the Wastelands. Kill Ant Recruits, Ant Patrols, Ant Guards, Noble Ants and Noble Ant Leaders.\n
short_description: The forbidden spellbook, used to protect against the devil Beleth, immediately transformed the once-fertile land south of Aden into a barren wasteland. Now, at last, Elder Casian has hopes of rekindling life there.

description: Seer Reva of Aden Castle Town asks you to find an ancient ash urn. You can obtain it by going to the Tower of Insolence and killing the followers of the evil Hallate. You will receive an extra reward if you bring back 100 ash urns at once. If in your search you happen to find an ancient porcelain, take it to antique dealer Patrin in the Town of Oren and get it appraised. Hunt Hallate's warriors, Hallate's knights and Hallate's commander.\n
short_description: The Tower of Insolence was built with the blood and bones of its many innocent victims. That place is haunted by the souls of those wrongly executed there! Would you pacify them?

description: Warehouse Keeper Walderal belongs to the Gray Pillar Guild. He needs a blueprint of the Tower of Insolence to further his research. Slay the powerful enemies in the Tower of Insolence and recover the blueprint! If you find other books, ask Walderal about them. You must kill the corrupt sages, Erin Ediunce, Hallate's inspectors, platinum tribe overlords, platinum guardian prefects and messenger angels.\n
short_description: The Tower of Insolence is definitely one of the most marvelous structures in history! The Gray Pillar Guild, expert architects, felt they had to reclaim the inheritance of their Dwarven ancestors' technology.

description:
Warehouse Keeper Walderal needs the blueprints for the Tower of Insolence. Defeat the powerful monsters in the Tower of Insolence and retrieve the blueprints. You should also look for some books that other people have been asking for.

Take "The Revelation of the Seals" to Madam Claudia Athebalt near Aden Castle or Magister Desmond in Aden Castle Town. Take "The Imperial Genealogy" to Trader Holly in Aden Castle Town. Take "The Ancient Epic" to Antique Dealer Patrin in the Town of Oren.

Monsters to Hunt - corrupt sages, Erin Ediunce, Hallate's inspectors, platinum tribe overlords, platinum guardian prefects and messenger angels.
short_description: The Tower of Insolence is definitely one of the most marvelous structures in history! The Gray Pillar Guild, expert architects, felt they had to reclaim the inheritance of their Dwarven ancestors' technology.

description: Seer Manakia wants to perform a ritual to better predict the future. He asks you to obtain the items he needs. He needs 65 molars of cave beasts and 65 flames of death wave.\n
short_description: A dark chaos is about to descend upon the world! Seer Manakia received a warning in a dream, and is planning a ceremony to try and better understand the coming darkness...

description: Take the sealed mysterious stone to Dwarf Torai near the entrance to Dragon Valley.\n
short_description: A dark chaos is about to descend upon the world! Seer Manakia received a warning in a dream, and is planning a ceremony to try and better understand the coming darkness...

description: Show the mysterious stone to Seer Manakia. If you wish to help him, obtain the molars of cave beasts and flames of death wave he needs for the ritual.\n
short_description: A dark chaos is about to descend upon the world! Seer Manakia received a warning in a dream, and is planning a ceremony to try and better understand the coming darkness...

description: Seer Manakia asks you to obtain 100 skulls of cave howler and 100 horns of karik.\n
short_description: Seer Manakia is not able to adequately foresee the coming darkness. He asks for help in acquiring better materials.

main_name: Exploration of the Giants' Cave, Part I
description: Head Researcher Sobling asks you to find the relics of ancient Titans that are guarded by monsters in the cave. Hunt yintzus, paliotes, hamruts and kranrots.\n
short_description: Dwarf Sobling solved the puzzle of the past and revealed the truth. There's still something else he needs to do at Giants Cave.

main_name: Exploration of the Giants' Cave, Part I
description: Head Researcher Sobling asks you to take the mysterious book to Warehouse Freightman Cliff in the Town of Oren.\n
short_description: Dwarf Sobling solved the puzzle of the past and revealed the truth. There's still something else he needs to do at Giants Cave.

main_name: Exploration of the Giants' Cave, Part I
description: Show Head Researcher Sobling the "Ancient Language Dictionary: Intermediate Level". If you wish to continue helping Sobling, you must bring him relics of ancient Titans. Hunt yintzus, paliotes, hamruts and kranrots.\n
short_description: Dwarf Sobling solved the puzzle of the past and revealed the truth. There's still something else he needs to do at Giants Cave.

description: Head Researcher Sobling asks you to find the relics of the Titans from the deepest recesses of Giants Cave using the newly acquired "Ancient Language Dictionary: Intermediate Level". Hunt lesser giant soldiers, lesser giant scouts, lesser giant mages and lesser giant elders.\n
restricions: Dictionary of Ancient Languages: Intermediate Level
short_description: Sobling's efforts are finally starting to pay off. However, he says that there is still room for improvement.

description: Help Guard Harlan of the Town of Dion by obtaining and bringing back some top quality wine!\n
restricions: Fantasy Wine, adept of Taste, Bring out the Flavor of Ingredients Quest has been fulfilled
short_description: Chief Warehouse Keeper Lansfo has taken care of the warehouse at Dion for 40 years. Now he's been offered the promotion of a lifetime!

description: Meet with Musician Barbado in the Town of Dion and obtain the Musical Score - Theme of the Feast.\n
restricions: Fantasy Wine, adept of Taste, Bring out the Flavor of Ingredients Quest has been fulfilled
short_description: Chief Warehouse Keeper Lansfo has taken care of the warehouse at Dion for 41 years. Now he's been offered the promotion of a lifetime!

description: Meet with Jonas, a would-be chef, and obtain his secret recipe.\n
restricions: Fantasy Wine, adept of Taste, Bring out the Flavor of Ingredients Quest has been fulfilled
short_description: Chief Warehouse Keeper Lansfo has taken care of the warehouse at Dion for 42 years. Now he's been offered the promotion of a lifetime!

description: Meet with Magister Rollant and obtain his recipe for desserts. He is located in the temple of the Town of Dion.\n
restricions: Fantasy Wine, adept of Taste, Bring out the Flavor of Ingredients Quest has been fulfilled
short_description: Chief Warehouse Keeper Lansfo has taken care of the warehouse at Dion for 43 years. Now he's been offered the promotion of a lifetime!

description: It is the tradition of Guard Harlan's family in Dion Village to make wine whenever a new child is born. To celebrate the birth of a daughter, they plan to make fantasy wine. They need 80 leaves of eucalyptus and 100 stones of chill. Hunt Enku orc champions and Enku orc shamans.\n
short_description: Fathers would brave the fires of hell for their daughters! Guard Harlan of Dion is no exception.

description: You have collected all the ingredients. Take them to Guard Harlan in the Town of Dion.\n
short_description: Fathers would brave the fires of hell for their daughters! Guard Harlan of Dion is no exception.

main_name: Bring Out the Flavor of Ingredients!
description: Magister Rollant of Dion Castle is an aspiring chef. He has become disillusioned by the shoddy practices of other chefs. Bring him four ritron fruits, 20 moon face flowers, 10 drops of leech fluids and two antidotes and he will make a top quality dish that is far superior to anything else. Hunt dire wolves, Kadif werewolves and giant mist leeches.\n
short_description: Dion is always packed for its monthly cooking contest. One magister who likes to cook plans to embarrass the other cooks with his expert technique!

main_name: Bring Out the Flavor of Ingredients!
description: You have collected all the ingredients. Make sure that you have two antidotes and return to Magister Rollant in the Town of Dion.\n
short_description: Dion is always packed for its monthly cooking contest. One magister who likes to cook plans to embarrass the other cooks with his expert technique!

main_name: Bring Out the Flavor of Ingredients!
prog_name: Waiting For the Dish to Be Ready
description: Rollant is cooking. Come back later.\n
short_description: Dion is always packed for its monthly cooking contest. One magister who likes to cook plans to embarrass the other cooks with his expert technique!

main_name: Bring Out the Flavor of Ingredients!
prog_name: Waiting For the Dish to Be Ready
description: Rollant is cooking. Be patient.\n
short_description: Dion is always packed for its monthly cooking contest. One magister who likes to cook plans to embarrass the other cooks with his expert technique!

main_name: Bring Out the Flavor of Ingredients!
prog_name: Waiting For the Dish to Be Ready
description: He is still cooking. Wait!\n
short_description: Dion is always packed for its monthly cooking contest. One magister who likes to cook plans to embarrass the other cooks with his expert technique!

main_name: Bring Out the Flavor of Ingredients!
prog_name: Waiting For the Dish to Be Ready
description: Rollant is still cooking. It's taking him forever!\n
short_description: Dion is always packed for its monthly cooking contest. One magister who likes to cook plans to embarrass the other cooks with his expert technique!

description: Warehouse Keeper Sorint explains that a royal membership program has recently been introduced for level 1 members. To become royalty you must obtain Kail's coin from the monsters of the Forsaken Plains. You must also obtain the coin collecting album sold by Trader Sandra in Giran. Hunt ancient gargoyles.\n
restricions: Coin Collector Membership - 1, Completion of the Coins of Magic Quest
short_description: The Coin Collectors Club has members from every land! Would you care to take the test to join?

description: Head Blacksmith Vergara has just joined the coin collecting club. He wants to trade his coins for rarer coins. Bring the coins Vergara wants so that he will give you the coins you want. Hunt fallen orcs, fallen orc archers, fallen orc shamans and fallen orc captains.\n
short_description: Kail, known as th right hand of the devil Beleth, had a habit of making weird coins. There is a certain collector who collects no others...

description: Ask Trader Espen of Heine to decipher the pirate's treasure map for you.\n
short_description: The legendary Pirate Captain Zaken left many legends and even more bodies in his wake! One story tells of his treasure, and it seems to be the one most people want to hear... Trader Espen can tell you more!

description: The pirate's treasure map has disclosed the location of the hidden treasure chest! Go to the place marked on the map.\n
short_description: The legendary Pirate Captain Zaken left many legends and even more bodies in his wake! One story tells of his treasure, and it seems to be the one most people want to hear... Trader Espen can tell you more!

description:
Some Warehouse Keeper's medals that were being delivered to the Town of Oren were stolen by monsters. Recover them and take them to Warehouse Freightman Cliff of the Town of Oren or Warehouse Chief Baxt of Hunters Village and you'll be allowed to play bingo.

Monsters to Hunt -
Tanor Canyon: nightmare lords, nightmare keepers and nightmare guides.
Dragon Valley: hunter gargoyles, dustwind gargoyles, thunder wyrms, dragon bearer chiefs, dragon bearer warriors, and dragon bearer archers.
Skyshadow Meadow: connabis, sanhidros, cadeines, innersens, luminuns, and bartal.
 Sea of Spores: rotting golems, and giant monstereyes.
Outlaw Forest: hunter gargoyles.
 Hunters Valley: weird drakes.
 Blazing Swamp: tulbens, konzur bat lords, and konzur bats. 
The Cemetery: grave guards.
 Forest of Mirrors: carinkains.
short_description: Trading is mind-numbing work! Freightmen must make up their own ways to kill time.

description: The Gatekeeper Ziggurat wants to become a human again and asks you to slay the guardians of ancient magic and collect the scrolls of ancient magic. You'll receive a blank scroll as a reward. The blank scroll will be helpful when dealing with the Trader of Mammon. Journey into the necropolises and catacombs and find monsters whose name contain lookout, watcher, guard, monk, overlord, shaman, consul, inquisitor, guardian, Elder, court guard, and preacher. Exclude Nephilim, Lilim, Gigant and Lith.\n
short_description: The Gate Keeper Ziggurat, who longs to become Human again, asks you to slay the guardians and collect the scrolls of ancient magic.

prog_name: Hunt Dungeon Monsters for an Offering
description: Slay as many of evil creatures as you can within 18 minutes and collect the blood offering! \nIf you wish to quit without completing the festival, or if you wish to make the festival more challenging, speak with a Festival Witch.\n
restricions: Level appropriate group.  Only available during SSQ Competition Period.
short_description: Kill as many evil creatures as possible within 18 minutes!

description: You have agreed to obtain the reagent that Magic Trader Wesley needs for his magic research. Slay the evil creatures in the Tower of Insolence and the Blazing Swamp and collect reagent ingredients. Once you collect the ingredients, use the mixing urn in the basement of the Ivory Tower to create reagents. Refer to the note that is attached to the mixing urn for instructions on how to use the urn and for the formulas used to mix the ingredients. description:
Blacksmith Vulcan is collecting the Torches located in the lower level of the Forge of the Gods. You can obtain them by slaying the monsters within the Forge of the Gods. Take 1,000 Torches to Vulcan and he will give you a random S-grade weapon recipe.
Blacksmith Rooney, who is wandering in the Forge of the Gods, is also collecting the Torches. Take 1,200 Torches to him and he will give you an S-grade weapon recipe of your choice.

Monsters to Hunt - All monsters in the Forge of the Gods
short_description: Vulcan is collecting flames in the lower level of the Forge of the Gods. He'll give you a special reward if you defeat all the monsters there and bring him the flames that you collect.

prog_name: In Search of Fragments of Dimension
description:
You must obtain a Dimensional Fragment if you intend to fight within the Dimensional Rift.

Monsters to Hunt - Necropolis, Catacombs: monsters whose name contains Lookout, Watcher, Guard, Monk, Overlord, Shaman, Consul, Inquisitor, Guardian, Elder, Court Guard and Preacher, excluding Nephilim, Lilim, Gigant and Lilith.
short_description: You need a Dimensional Fragment in order to temporarily stay within the Dimensional Rift. Get as many Dimensional Fragments as possible.

description: Defeat the devils within the Dimensional Rift.\n
short_description: Destroy all of the monsters within the Dimensional Rift.  The number of teleports are limited, so you must work quickly!

description:
Lately, Langk Lizardmen's attacks have sharply increased on the south coast road to Giran. The guards have asked you to destroy the lizardmen that are disturbing the peace.

Monsters to Hunt - Langk lizardman Sentinels, Langk lizardman Lieutenants
short_description: The primitive tribe of Langk Lizardmen in the southern part of Gludio Territory have been using a spell unknown to even the Mystics of the Ivory Tower.

description: You've defeated the Langk Lizardmen that have been threatening the southern coast road. Return to Guard Luis of Gludin Village.\n
short_description: The primitive tribe of Langk Lizardmen in the southern part of Gludio Territory have been using a spell unknown to even the Mystics of the Ivory Tower.

description: You discover a strange tooth among the warriors' effects. Ask Magister Iris about it.\n
short_description: The primitive tribe of Langk Lizardmen in the southern part of Gludio Territory have been using a spell unknown to even the Mystics of the Ivory Tower.

description: Magister Iris was able to identify the tooth as coming from a dragon, but is unable to control it. She suggests that you ask Magister Rohmer in the Town of Gludio.\n
short_description: The primitive tribe of Langk Lizardmen in the southern part of Gludio Territory have been using a spell unknown to even the Mystics of the Ivory Tower.

description: An expert in the sorcery of lizardmen, Magister Rohmer has important reference data and asks you to deliver it to Magister Iris at once.\n
short_description: The primitive tribe of Langk Lizardmen in the southern part of Gludio Territory have been using a spell unknown to even the Mystics of the Ivory Tower.

description:
Magister Iris has discovered the secret of the dragon's tooth. To destroy the savage sorcery, she must have many more of the teeth. She asks you to steal 50 teeth from the lizardmen.

Monsters to Hunt - Langk lizardman Shamans, Langk lizardman Leaders
short_description: The primitive tribe of Langk Lizardmen in the southern part of Gludio Territory have been using a spell unknown to even the Mystics of the Ivory Tower.

description: You've collected the 50 dragon's teeth that Magister Iris asked for. Take them to her.\n
short_description: The primitive tribe of Langk Lizardmen in the southern part of Gludio Territory have been using a spell unknown to even the Mystics of the Ivory Tower.

description: Guard Babenco of the Town of Gludio has  recently noticed increased movements of Lizardmen on the west side of town and he's seeking recruits to help defeat them. All volunteers should report to Captain Bathis.\n
short_description: The red eyes of the Maille Lizardmen behold the dark shadows cast by war-ravaged Gludio Castle.

description:
Taking advantage of confusion after the war, a savage tribe, Maille Lizardman, that came into the center of Gludio is gaining its power. Captain Bathis orders you to destroy the Maille Lizardmen's vanguard and bring 100 Red Bone Necklaces and 100 Black Bone Necklaces as the evidence.

Monsters to Hunt - Maille Lizardman, Maille Lizardman Scout, Maille Lizardman Guard
short_description: The red eyes of the Maille Lizardmen behold the dark shadows cast by war-ravaged Gludio Castle.

description: You've destroyed the Maille Lizardmen. Take your trophies to Captain Bathis.\n
short_description: The red eyes of the Maille Lizardmen behold the dark shadows cast by war-ravaged Gludio Castle.

description:
When Captain Bathis received the report that Arachnids showed up during the previous battle, he suspected that there might be a conspiracy between the Maille Lizardmen and the Arachnids. He has asked you to investigate the possibility of a relationship between them.  Investigate both sides and look for evidence of a conspiracy. 

Monsters to Hunt - Maille Lizardman Guards, Maille Lizardman Scouts and Giant Arachnids
short_description: The red eyes of the Maille Lizardmen behold the dark shadows cast by war-ravaged Gludio Castle.

description: After much searching, you've discovered the clues to the conspiracy! Return to Captain Bathis.\n
short_description: The red eyes of the Maille Lizardmen behold the dark shadows cast by war-ravaged Gludio Castle.

description: Magister Rohmer of the Town of Gludio has been observing the activities of the Maille Lizardmen on the west side of town. Guard Praga asks you to deliver the data and reports his men have collected to Magister Rohmer.\n
short_description: The Maille Lizardmen slowly and menacingly approach the castle. Their secret power will soon be revealed.

description:
You've discovered the sorcery the Maille Lizardmen use to control the spiders. Magister Rohmer can render their sorcery useless if he can only get enough beads. Bring him some beads!

Monsters to Hunt - Maille Lizardman Warriors, Maille Lizardman Shamans, Maille Lizardman Matriarchs, Poison Arachnids and King Arachnids

description: You've discovered clues to the conspiracy between the Maille Lizardmen and the arachnids. Return to Magister Rohmer.\n

short_description: Rafforty is recruiting adventurers to help the Zinnia Guild.

description: Misa tells you to give her letter to Rafforty. \n
short_description: Rafforty is recruiting adventurers to help the Zinnia Guild.

description: Rafforty is sorry that he doubted you.\n
short_description: Rafforty is recruiting adventurers to help the Zinnia Guild.

description: Rafforty says that he belongs to the Zinnia Guild and asks for your help. \n
short_description: Rafforty is recruiting adventurers to help the Zinnia Guild.

description: Rafforty says he has heard a different story, and asks you to come back later.\n
short_description: Rafforty is getting adventurers involved in the goals of his guild, the Zinnia Guild.

description: Rafferty tells you that he has received new information from Misa. He asks you to meet with her after nightfall, so you'll have to travel in the dark. \n
short_description: Rafforty is recruiting adventurers to help the Zinnia Guild.

prog_name: In search of the Ice Sculpture
description: Misa says the missing informants have already been turned into ice sculptures. Go and find them. \n
short_description: Rafforty is recruiting adventurers to help the Zinnia Guild.

description: You have obtained the information about Kierre's whereabouts. Go to Kierre.\n
short_description: Rafforty is recruiting adventurers to help the Zinnia Guild.

description: You have obtained a report from Kierre, who now is an ice sculpture. Take the report to Rafforty.\n
short_description: Rafforty is recruiting adventurers to help the Zinnia Guild.

description: Rafforty asks you to wait while he decodes the cryptogram.  \n
short_description: Rafforty is recruiting adventurers to help the Zinnia Guild.

description: Rafforty needs the Tablet Fragments for his decryption spell. You remember seeing the fragments. Go to the place where the ice sculptures are located. \n
short_description: Rafforty is recruiting adventurers to help the Zinnia Guild.

description: You've found the Tablet Fragments. Return to Rafforty.\n
short_description: Rafforty is recruiting adventurers to help the Zinnia Guild.

description:
Rafforty asks you to find a Silver Ice Crystal. They are guarded by creatures in the Frozen Labyrinth. 

Monsters to Hunt: Massive Maze Bandersnatch, Lost Watcher, Elder Lost Watcher, Panthera, Lost Gargoyle, Lost Gargoyle Youngling, Pronghorn, Pronghorn Spirit, Ice Tarantula, Frost Tarantula, Frost Iron Golem, Frost Buffalo, Lost Baffalo, Ursus, Lost Yeti, Frost Yeti
short_description: Rafforty is collecting crystals of ice for his guild.

description:
Rafforty thanks you and tells you to save any Silver Hemocytes you may acquire for future needs. He also says that if you return with a Black Ice Crystal, he will give you a reward as a small token of appreciation for all your help. 
You can make a Black Ice Crystal from the Ice Shelf. 

Monsters to Hunt: Massive Maze Bandersnatch, Lost Watcher, Elder Lost Watcher, Panthera, Lost Gargoyle, Lost Gargoyle Youngling, Pronghorn, Pronghorn Spirit, Ice Tarantula, Frost Tarantula, Frost Iron Golem, Frost Buffalo, Lost Buffalo, Ursus, Lost Yeti, Frost Yeti
short_description: Rafforty is collecting ice crystals for his guild.

description: You have encountered Ivan, a disturbed youth who ran away from the Fishermen's Guild. You gave him a Scroll of Escape because he regretted what he'd done and wanted to return home. Go and meet with Ivan's father, Batidae, the Fishing Guild Member of the Town of Schuttgart to make sure Ivan is learning his craft well (and that he won't go on anymore adventures.)\n
short_description: When you meet a Fisherman's son who ran away because he didn't want to be part of the family business, convince him to return home.

prog_name: Did the Old Adventurer Return Home?
description: You met an aged ex-adventurer. The old man had run out of Soulshots in a dangerous hunting ground, and could not travel freely.  You shared your Soulshots with him, allowing him to return home. Go to the Town of Oren and meet with Sara, his daughter-in-law, to find out if the old man made it home safely.\n
short_description: The aged ex-adventurer left home for some excitement and found serious trouble. If you encounter him during the adventure, help him out.

description: You helped a young woman who had run off with a vagabond. When they broke up, she was lost. Go meet with her father to find out if she made it home safely.
short_description: If you meet Suki, who ran away because she fell in love with a vagabond, convince her to go back home.

main_name: I'd Rather Be Collecting Fairy Breath
description:
The Head Summoner Galatea thinks that one of the reasons the southern area of Gludio is in ruin is because the balance of fairy energy has been disrupted. She is researching possible causes.
Help her efforts by defeating the mad wind fairies on Windy Hill and collecting the last sighs of the fairies.

Monsters to Hunt: Sobbing Wind, Babbling Wind, Giggling Wind, Singing Wind, Whispering Wind
short_description: Collect the breath of Wind Sylph, the wind fairy, on Windy Hill.

description: Floran Village needs help in their fight against their oppressive lord. Meet with Captain Alex in Floran Village.\n
short_description: The Floran Village is a farmers' commune. The village has been growing, but needs some extra help these days.

prog_name: Eliminate the Monsters in Floran Clearing
description:
The Floran Village farmers cannot depend on the Territorial Army to protect them anymore. Defeat the monsters in the Floran Clearing and take evidence of your success to Captain Alex.

Monsters to Hunt: Watchman of the Plains, Cursed Seer, Roughly Hewn Rock Golem, Delu Lizardmen Supplier, Delu Lizardmen Special Agent, Delu Lizardmen Commander, Shaman of the Delu Lizardmen
short_description: The Floran Village is a farmers' commune. The village has been growing, but needs some extra help these days.

description:
The lord of Gludio Territory is trying to revive his war-torn lands. 
Fellmere Harvesting Grounds provide vital building supplies for that effort, but the area's monsters are preventing the masons from building a needed plantation there. 
The lord wants to solve this problem with the help of a brave adventurer.

Monsters to Hunt: Giant Poison Bee, Cloudy Beast, Young Araneid
short_description: Secure the Fellmere Harvesting Grounds so the masons can work safely.

main_name: A Grand Plan for Taming Wild Beasts
description: Collect 10 Crystals of Purity as proof of your ability to train wild beasts. To acquire the crystals, make sure you stay close to the beasts after taming them. Any member of the same clan may train the now tamed beasts.\n
restricions: Clan Leader, Over Clan Level 4, 1hour before the Clan Hall War
short_description: The clan that can best tame the wild beasts can obtain a clan hall.

main_name: A Grand Plan for Taming Wild Beasts
description: You've collected all 10 Crystals of Purity the messenger asked for. Show them to the messenger.\n
restricions: Clan Leader, Over Clan Level 4, 1hour before the Clan Hall War
short_description: The clan that can best tame the wild beasts can obtain a clan hall.

main_name: A Grand Plan for Taming Wild Beasts
description: You have obtained Trainer Certification! Speak to the messenger to register for the Preliminary Contest.\n
restricions: Clan Leader, Over Clan Level 4, 1 hour before the Clan Hall War
short_description: The clan who can tame the wild beast can obtain a clan hall.

description:
High Priest Innocentin is trying to prevent the pagans from capturing the Grail of Splendor. Innocentin will reward you if you defeat the monsters in the Temple of the Pagans and collect more than 2000 pagan totems. 

Monsters to Hunt: All the monsters in the Temple of the Pagans
short_description: High Priest Innocentin of the Rune Township is trying to prevent the pagans from capturing the Grail of Splendor.

description:
Priest Dominic is trying to obtain something hidden in the Monastery of Silence. He will reward you if you can bring the Monk Scriptures to him.
In addition, he asks you to help Gremory if you meet him in the Monestary.

Monsters to Hunt: All the monsters in the Monestary of Silence
short_description: Priest Dominic of the Rune Township is trying to obtain something hidden in the Monastery of Silence.

description: Gremory has snuck into the Monastery of Silence and is looking for the Grail of Splendor. He asks you to examine the Grail in the Room of Splendor.\n
short_description: Priest Dominic of the Rune Township is trying to obtain something hidden in the Monastery of Silence.

description: You have finished looking over the Grail in the Room of Splendor as Gremory asked. Return to Gremory.\n
short_description: Priest Dominic of the Rune Township is trying to obtain something hidden in the Monastery of Silence.

description:
Since you examined the Grail for him, Gremory will exchange 4000 Monk's Scriptures for an Enchant Weapon Scroll (S-Grade) and 400 Monk's Scriptures for an Enchant Armor Scroll (S-Grade ).
Therefore, you can be rewarded by both Dominic and Gremory if you collect the Monk Scriptures.

Monsters to Hunt: All the monsters in the Monastery of Silence
short_description: Priest Dominic of the Rune Township is trying to obtain something hidden in the Monastery of Silence.

description:
The Dwarves who became ghosts and whose dreams were thwarted now wander the Sky Wagon Relic. Pay them your respects.

Monsters to Hunt: Forgotten Crewman, Vagabonds of the Ruins
restricions: Completion of the "Ocean of Distant Stars" quest
short_description: The Dwarves of the Sky Wagon Relic eventually went mad. Can they be saved?

main_name: A Looter and a Railroad Man
description: Railroad Worker Obi asked you to defeat the Rayito bandits and bring back 200 stolen items.\nMonsters to Hunt: Bandit Sweeper, Bandit Hound, Bandit Watchman, Bandit Undertaker, Bandit Assassin, Bandit Warrior, Bandit Inspector, Bandit Captain\n
short_description: Railroad Worker Obi in the Plunderous Plains is plagued by incessant bandit attacks. Help him!

main_name: A Looter and a Railroad Man
description: You've collected 200 items stolen by the Rayito bandits. Return to Railroad Worker Obi.\n
short_description: Railroad Worker Obi in the Plunderous Plains is plagued by incessant bandit attacks. Help him!

description:
Collector Gutenhagen has asked you to hunt Golems at the Pavel Ruins. 

Monsters to Hunt: Probe Golem Prodigy IV, Menacing Jackhammer Golem, Horrifying Cannon Golem I, Horrifying Cannon Golem IV, Cruel Vice Golem, Probe Golem Champion I, Horrifying Excavator Golem III, Bloodthirsty Ginzu Golem VII, Bloodthirsty Ginzu Golem II, Ginzu Golem Prodigy X, Horrifying Jackhammer Golem, Horrifying Cannon Golem, Horrifying Cannon Golem III, Deadly Ginzu Golem V, Horrifying Ginzu Golem V, Horrifying Cannon Golem VI, Epic Cannon Golem, Epic Cannon Golem Adjunct, Horrifying Ginzu Golem VIII, Deadly Ginzu Golem VIII
short_description: The Collector Gutenhagen wants to clear the Pavel Ruins of Golems in order to research them.

description: You've collected 500 fragments by hunting down the Golems in the Pavel Ruins. Return to Collector Gutenhagen in the Dwarven barracks.\n
short_description: The Collector Gutenhagen wants to clear the Pavel Ruins of Golems in order to research them.

description: Collector Yumi will be waiting for you in the Dwarven barracks located at Pavel Ruins. Meet with her and make haste.\n
short_description: The Pavel Ruins are near Schuttgart Village. What's going on there?

description: Gray Pillar's Filaur says he needs you to bring him the following items:\n20 Bandages, 5 Energy Stones, 10 Keys of the Thief.  When you get them all, return to Gray Pillar's Filaur.\n
short_description: The Dwarven Village is frozen. If you travel along the route of the southbound railroad and over the icy hill, you will come to the Plunderous Plains.

description: Gray Pillar's Filaur has asked you to deliver supplies to Railroad Worker Obi in the Plunderous Plains just beyond the passage to the mining areas.\n
short_description: The Dwarven Village is frozen. If you travel along the route of the southbound railroad and over the icy hill, you will come to the Plunderous Plains.

description: Collector Yumi is looking for a person willing to work in the Pavel Laboratory. Meet with her.\n
restricions: Completion of the "Pavel the Giant" quest
short_description: Riddles are hidden within the Pavel Ruins.  What great mystery lies there?

prog_name: In Search of a Wise Man
description: Collector Yumi asks you to gather information about the strange building in the south and whoever is living there. Visit an adviser who can tell you more about the building.\n
restricions: Completion of the "Pavel the Giant" quest
short_description: Riddles are hidden within the Pavel Ruins.  What great mystery lies there?

short_description: Riddles are hidden within the Pavel Ruins.  What great mystery lies there?

short_description: Riddles are hidden within the Pavel Ruins.  What great mystery lies there?

short_description: Riddles are hidden within the Pavel Ruins.  What great mystery lies there?

description: Bring the stack of stones to the Dwarf Guild to get the Starstone. Find the Head Blacksmith Newyear of the Town of Schuttgart!\n
restricions: Completion of the "Pavel the Giant" quest
short_description: Riddles are hidden within the Pavel Ruins.  What great mystery lies there?

description: You have received the Starstone from Newyear. Return to Yumi.\n

short_description: Riddles are hidden within the Pavel Ruins.  What great mystery lies there?

restricions: Completion of the "Pavel the Giant" quest

description: You have the Starstone! Return to Wendy.\n

description: You can use the Starstone after you return to Yumi.\n

short_description: Riddles are hidden within the Pavel Ruins.  What great mystery lies there?

restricions: Completion of the "Pavel the Giant" quest
short_description: Riddles are hidden within the Pavel Ruins.  What great mystery lies there?

description: The stack of stones says its name is Atlanta. Why did it awaken Atlanta?\n
restricions: Completion of the "Resurrection of an Old Manager" quest
short_description: The old relics have been awakened by mistake. Enormous energy is flowing in. Stop the approaching danger!

prog_name: The Child who was With Atlanta
description: The stack of stones that identified itself as Atlanta asks you to look for a child who was with it. Where is the child?\n
restricions: Completion of the "Resurrection of an Old Manager" quest
short_description: The old relics have been awakened by mistake. Enormous energy is flowing in. Stop the approaching danger!

description: Yumi thinks that the child is a Golem and tells you to speak to Wendy first.\n
restricions: Completion of the "Resurrection of an Old Manager" quest

description: There is something suspicious about Wendy. Go to Wendy!\n

restricions: Completion of the "Resurrection of an Old Manager" quest
short_description: The old relics have been awakened by mistake. Enormous energy is flowing in. Stop the approaching danger!

restricions: Completion of the "Resurrection of an Old Manager" quest
short_description: The old relics have been awakened by mistake. Enormous energy is flowing in. Stop the approaching danger!

description: Yumi told you about the history of the ruins. If the Guardian Golem that Dr. Chaos awoke is revived, it will be disastrous! Go to Wendy and ask her about Dr. Chaos's activities.\n
restricions: Completion of the "Resurrection of an Old Manager" quest
short_description: The old relics have been awakened by mistake. Enormous energy is flowing in. Stop the approaching danger!

description: Wendy knows that Dr. Chaos has created some sort of device. In order to find out what it is, go to Atlanta and ask about "N.45 Arrival of Eternal Spring."\n
restricions: Completion of the "Resurrection of an Old Manager" quest
short_description: The old relics have been awakened by mistake. Enormous energy is flowing in. Stop the approaching danger!

description: Atlanta's password will allow you to enter the North Wing, which is the primary area of the experiment. Memorize the password and go to the Weathermaster in the North Wing.\nLearn about the lab's security devices before progressing further.\n
restricions: Completion of the "Resurrection of an Old Manager" quest
short_description: The old relics have been awakened by mistake. Enormous energy is flowing in. Stop the approaching danger!

description: The password has been approved! Now you must stop the prototype of the Arrival of Eternal Spring.\n
restricions: Completion of the "Resurrection of an Old Manager" quest
short_description: The old relics have been awakened by mistake. Enormous energy is flowing in. Stop the approaching danger!

restricions: Completion of the "Resurrection of an Old Manager" quest

restricions: Completion of the "Resurrection of an Old Manager" quest

description: You bypassed all the traps and retrieved the book!\nBut how do you use it? Perhaps Yumi or Wendy knows.\n

restricions: Completion of the "Resurrection of an Old Manager" quest

description: They say that the Elroki tribe, inhabitants of the Primeval Isle, possesses a mysterious skill that allows them to effortlessly hunt dinosaurs. Find the Elrokian chief and ask him about that skill. \n
short_description: On Primeval Isle, where primitive creatures abound, the natives are said to have a special skill for hunting dinosaurs. To learn it, you must first win the trust of these natives...

description: The Elrokian chief Mushika is gravely ill, and it is difficult to speak with him. Speak with his son instead. \n
short_description: On Primeval Isle, where primitive creatures abound, the natives are said to have a special skill for hunting dinosaurs. To learn it, you must first win the trust of these natives...

description: You speak with Asamah, the chief's son, but he turns you away because you are an outsider. Return to Marquez and find a way to win the friendship of the Elroki tribe. \n
short_description: On Primeval Isle, where primitive creatures abound, the natives are said to have a special skill for hunting dinosaurs. To learn it, you must first win the trust of these natives...

prog_name: Retrieve the Diary Fragments from the Velociraptors
description:
To become a friend of the Elroki tribe, you must know their traditional song. To learn it, defeat the Velociraptors that killed the expedition member who was searching for clues about the song and retrieve the fragments of his diary. The Velociraptors are said to roam the Primeval Isle's "Lost Nest." 

 Monster to Hunt: Velociraptor.
short_description: On Primeval Isle, where primitive creatures abound, the natives are said to have a special skill for hunting dinosaurs. To learn it, you must first win the trust of these natives...

prog_name: Take the Diary Fragments to Marquez
description: You have collected all the diary fragments. Return to Marquez. \n
short_description: On Primeval Isle, where primitive creatures abound, the natives are said to have a special skill for hunting dinosaurs. To learn it, you must first win the trust of these natives...

description: According to the diary, an old Elrokian hunter named Kirikachin may be willing to teach the song to an outsider. Find him, deliver the letter and learn the song. \n
short_description: On Primeval Isle, where primitive creatures abound, the natives are said to have a special skill for hunting dinosaurs. To learn it, you must first win the trust of these natives...

description: After reading the letter, Kirikachin seems very sad. Comfort him and learn the song. \n
short_description: On Primeval Isle, where primitive creatures abound, the natives are said to have a special skill for hunting dinosaurs. To learn it, you must first win the trust of these natives...

description: You have learned the sad but proud Elrokian tune, the "Warrior's Song." Go to Asamah, the chief's son, and sing it to him. \n
short_description: On Primeval Isle, where primitive creatures abound, the natives are said to have a special skill for hunting dinosaurs. To learn it, you must first win the trust of these natives...

description: You sing before Asamah, and all the Elrokians nearby join in the Warrior's Song. The act wins you the friendship of the Elroki tribe, and Asamah is now willing to speak with you. \n

description:

description: The Humans and the Elrokians are currently hostile towards each other. Nevertheless, at the Primeval Isle's wharf, the old explorer Marquez asks you to help the Elroki tribe.
short_description: The old Primeval Isle explorer Marquez has received a letter from his friend, the Elroki chief Mushika. The chief asks Marquez to send him a brave young adventurer who can search the island for a cure for his mysterious illness.

description: Marquez is an old friend of Elroki Chief Mushika, who lives on the Primeval Plains. Marquez tells you that Mushika is deathly ill and needs the help of an adventurer to find the cure. Travel inland to meet with Asamah, the chief's son, in order to learn the details. \n

description:
The discovery of powerful primitive creatures on the Primeval Isle has sparked the interest of magicians curious about the creatures' origin and blacksmiths eager to learn what items can be crafted from the creatures' hides, bones and claws. Dinn asks that you scavenge the carcasses of Dinosaurs you kill for any useful remains. He also offers a reward to anyone who brings him 1 Dinosaur Egg and 150 Dinosaur Tissues. 

 Monsters to Hunt: Velociraptor, Pterosaur, Ornithomimus, Deinonychus, Dinosaur Egg.
short_description: The discovery of powerful primitive creatures on the Primeval Isle has sparked interest from the magicians, who are curious about the creatures' origin, and from the blacksmiths, who are interested in what items can be crafted from the creatures. Both groups are eager to find adventurers willing to brave the dangers of Primeval Isle to bring back the research ingredients they need.

main_name: Rise and Fall of the Elroki Tribe
description:
The Magician Pillbug, who is researching ancient creatures, needs dinosaur bones as research ingredients. The Primeval Isle's native shaman also needs dinosaur bones for some ritual. 

 Monsters to Hunt: Pachycephalosaurus, Wild Striders
short_description: Powerful primitive creatures called dinosaurs abound on Primeval Isle. The magicians want dinosaur bones for their research, while the native Elrokians need dinosaur bones to help restore the tribe to its former glory. Both groups need an adventurer willing to defeat the dinosaurs and return with the needed bones.
